title: Resolution urging Congress to let veterans use VA loans for co-ops
summary: This resolution calls on Congress to pass H.R. 1803, the Fair Access to Co-ops for Veterans Act of 2025, and for the President to sign it. The bill would expand the VA Home Loan Guaranty program to let veterans, servicemembers and surviving spouses buy co-op apartments, not just condos and houses. Supporters say this would help veterans in New York City, where co-ops make up nearly two-thirds of multifamily housing stock.
